title: Release of Additional Papers and Cabinet Minute on State-Owned Enterprises as a Tool for Promoting Economic Growth

16 June 2006

Release of Additional Papers and Cabinet Minute on State-Owned Enterprises as a Tool for Promoting Economic Growth

  • Trevor Mallard
State Owned Enterprises

These papers relate to an announcement made on June 2 by State Owned Enterprises Minister Trevor Mallard. The June 2 press statement on this announcement is also available at www.beehive.govt.nz/mallard

The papers are as follows:
